summary: First Tracks Biotherapeutics filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its spin-off from AnaptysBio on April 20, 2026. Each AnaptysBio shareholder received one share of First Tracks common stock for each share held as of the April 6 record date. Concurrently, the company closed a private placement, issuing 5,791,478 shares and selling stockholder EcoR1 Capital selling 4,705,575 shares, both at $13.81/share. The separation is governed by a Separation and Distribution Agreement and Transition Services Agreement. Watch for post-spin trading dynamics and potential shareholder value creation as a pure-play biotech.
